en.t: Prince Genji lay down to rest.

units.source_text: 其时僧都的徒弟来了，把惟光叫出去，向他传达僧都的口信。

en.t: Just then, the Sozu's disciple came, called Koremitsu outside, and delivered the Sozu's message to him.

units.source_text: 地方狭小，不待惟光转达，源氏公子已经听到。

en.t: The place was so cramped that Prince Genji heard it before Koremitsu could relay the message.

units.source_text: 但闻那徒弟说：“大驾到此，贫僧此刻方始闻知，应该倒屣前来请安。

en.t: He only heard the disciple say, "I have only just learned of your honored arrival here, and should have rushed over at once to pay my respects.

units.source_text: 但念贫僧在此修行，乃公子所素知，今公子秘密微行，深恐不便相扰，因此未敢前来。

en.t: But since Your Highness already knows that this poor monk is practicing here, and since you have come privately and in secrecy, I feared it would be improper to disturb you, and so did not dare come before you.

units.source_text: 今宵住宿，应由敝寺供奉，乞恕简慢。”

en.t: Tonight's lodging should be provided by our humble temple; please forgive our poor hospitality."

units.source_text: 源氏公子命惟光转复道：“我于十余日前忽患疟疾，屡屡发作，不堪其苦。

en.t: Prince Genji ordered Koremitsu to reply, "More than ten days ago I suddenly came down with malaria; the attacks have returned again and again, and the suffering is unbearable.

units.source_text: 经人指示，匆匆来此求治。

en.t: After someone directed me here, I hurried over to seek treatment.

units.source_text: 因念此乃德隆望重之高僧，与普通僧众不同，万一治病不验，消息外传，更是对他不起。

en.t: I considered that he is a highly virtuous and respected priest, quite unlike ordinary monks; if by some chance the treatment failed and word spread outside, it would be all the more unfair to him.

units.source_text: 有此顾虑，所以秘密前来。

en.t: Because I had this concern, I came in secret.

units.source_text: 我此刻即将到尊处访问。”

en.t: I will come to visit your honored quarters at once."

units.source_text: 徒弟去后，僧都立刻来了。

en.t: After the disciple left, the Sozu came immediately.

units.source_text: 这僧都虽然是个和尚，但人品甚高，为世人所敬仰。

en.t: Although this Sozu was a monk, his character was very noble, and he was admired by people of the world.

units.source_text: 源氏公子行色简陋，被他见了觉得不好意思。

en.t: Prince Genji felt embarrassed to be seen by him in such plain traveling attire.

units.source_text: 僧都便将入山修行种种情况向公子叙述。

en.t: The Sozu then described to the prince the various circumstances of entering the mountains for religious practice.

units.source_text: 随后请道：“敝处也是一所草庵，与此间无异；只是略有水池，或可聊供清赏。”

en.t: Then he invited him, saying, "My poor dwelling is also a thatched hermitage, no different from this place; it merely has a small pond, which may offer you a little refined pleasure."

units.source_text: 源氏公子想起这僧都曾经对那不相识的尼姑夸奖自己容貌之美，觉得不好意思前往。

en.t: Prince Genji remembered that this Sozu had once praised the beauty of his appearance to the unfamiliar nun, and felt embarrassed about going.

units.source_text: 但他很想知道那可爱的女孩的情况，便决心前去投宿了。

en.t: But he very much wanted to know about that lovely girl, and so he decided to go there and spend the night.
